name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until fully set and no longer runny.
Add the carrot and peas and stir-fry for two minutes.
Add the cooked rice, break up any clumps, and stir-fry until piping hot.
Pour in the soy sauce, add the spring onion, and toss for another minute before serving.
